mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following positive GDP growth, or GDP growth explains < 10% of SPX return variation over any 3-year window (R^2).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate signals a rapidly weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp+ unemployment rate spike, or the unemployment rate explains < 5% of SPX return variation over any 3-year window (R^2).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production signals a supply shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 2%+ industrial production decline, or industrial production explains < 10% of SPX return variation over any 3-year window (R^2).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of periods following a 0.5pp+ fed funds rate hike, or the fed funds rate explains < 15% of SPX return variation over any 3-year window (R^2).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real estate sales signals a weakening housing market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 10%+ real estate sales decline, or real estate sales explain < 5% of SPX return variation over any 3-year window (R^2).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in payroll employment signals a strengthening labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following a 300k+ payroll employment rise, or payroll employment explains < 10% of SPX return variation over any 3-year window (R^2).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in housing starts signals a strengthening housing market that will boost related sectors and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of periods following a 10%+ rise in housing starts, or housing starts explain < 10% of SPX return variation over any 3-year window (R^2).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index signals rising inflation expectations that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 1%+ CPI rise, or the CPI explains < 5% of SPX return variation over any 3-year window (R^2).
